newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan gross savings rise 8.6 percent in 1995/96.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan gross savings rise 8.6 percent in 1995/96.

text.p: Pakistan's gross national savings rose 8.6 percent to 298.6 billion rupees in fiscal 1995/96 (July-June), compared to an 11.7 percent increase in 1994/95, the State Bank of Pakistan said on Thursday.
The central bank said in its annual report that the share of national savings in gross national product fell to 13.6 percent from 14.6 percent in 1994/95.
